players.product: Chinese OSAT (Tongfu Microelectronics) buying Hanmi packaging equipment

quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and president Shi Lei (2025 annual results briefing): flip-chip and other advanced packaging products are in large-scale production and make up about 70% of revenue, and this year the company will expand that market further and step up R&D. Board secretary Jiang Shu said the company currently has no cooperation with Intel; it serves customers with CPU packaging and test needs, a business that kept growing well through 2025.
